description: A pair alarm is marked «being delivered» (alarm id, time) durably BEFORE the notification is shown and the mark is removed after saving. If the process ends in between, the next run finds the mark: a fresh mark (0 <= now - markerAt < freshMillis) while the notification is still shown means «already delivered» — the alarm is only saved, never sounded a second time. Otherwise the mark counts as an unconfirmed attempt (retry after the cooldown). Android AlarmDeliveryMarker.alreadyDelivered / iOS AlarmDelivery.alreadyDelivered. markerAt null = no mark. Cases with "postedAt" (instead of "shown") give the post time of the open notification of that alarm (null = none open); it only counts as shown when posted at or after the mark minus postedToleranceMillis (Android AlarmDeliveryMarker.shownSinceMarker / iOS AlarmDelivery.shownSinceMarker) — an older notification of the same alarm confirms nothing.

cases.name: posted within tolerance before the mark
older notification of the same alarm
posted after the mark but mark stale

savedSinceDescription: A mark whose trigger is already saved (the alarm's lastTriggeredAt >= markerAt; mark() saves with the same time as the mark) was left behind by a process that ended after saving. It is dropped and the alarm is reported normally — otherwise a new, real trigger of a repeating alarm would be saved silently as «already delivered». Android AlarmDeliveryMarker.savedSinceMarker / iOS AlarmDelivery.savedSinceMarker.

savedSinceCases.name: last trigger before the mark (not saved)

deliverDescription: Whole AlarmDelivery.deliver runs (alarm id 1, cooldownMinutes 0, notifications deliverable, show and mark succeed). markerAt = mark left by an earlier run (null = none), lastTriggeredAt = saved last trigger of the evaluated alarm, shown = the notification of the mark is still open, holdAlarms = quiet hours (default false). Expected: show called, mark called, mark afterwards (null = none), result of deliver.

deliverCases.name: left-behind mark after a saved trigger: the new trigger is reported
process ended between show and save: only save
left-behind mark, notification dismissed: no cooldown wait
unconfirmed attempt (not saved) waits for the cooldown
only save also during quiet hours
left-behind mark during quiet hours: dropped, nothing shown

resetDescription: May marks be cleared (database created anew) or pruned to the alarms of this run (pair/alarm deleted)? Not while the next process brings back the stored state: storedKept = stored file kept but unreadable (Android isStoredKept, iOS watchlist locked), volatileCopy = the stored alarms are only a copy in memory (iOS save pending while the old file is still there; never on Android, which passes false). Android AlarmDeliveryMarker.shouldClear / iOS AlarmDelivery.shouldClear.
